title: Learning to Reweight Examples for Robust Deep Learning

anchors.quote: Online approximation Calculating the optimal wi re- quires two nested loops
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 原始双层样本权重优化被近似成每个训练步的一步前瞻，并由独立干净验证批次产生样本权重。

anchors.quote: ratios averaged from 10 runs with random splits
anchors.paraphrase_zh: MNIST 类别不平衡实验按十次随机划分平均；CIFAR 噪声实验另按五个随机标签划分报告。

anchors.quote: does not grow after having more than 100 validation images
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 干净验证集规模消融显示收益在约一百张后趋于饱和，同时极小验证集仍可能带来抽样偏差。

anchors.quote: our method only slightly underperforms baseline
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 在零噪声条件下方法略低于普通训练，作者将其归因于验证子集自身的抽样偏差。

formulas: u_i,t = -eta * d validation_loss(theta_hat(epsilon))/d epsilon_i at epsilon_i=0
w_tilde_i,t = max(u_i,t,0), followed by within-batch L1 normalization
the meta-gradient contains dot products between training and validation gradient directions
algorithm_steps: Sample one noisy or biased training mini-batch and one small clean unbiased validation mini-batch at every optimizer step.
Set temporary example perturbation weights to zero and take one differentiable pseudo-update on the weighted training loss.
Differentiate the validation loss through that pseudo-update with respect to every training-example perturbation.
Rectify negative utility weights to zero, normalize positive weights within the batch, and update the real model on the reweighted training loss.
selection_timing: Weights are recomputed online at every training iteration from the current model, current training mini-batch and a newly sampled clean validation mini-batch.
refresh_rule: There is no persistent global ranking: every mini-batch begins with zero perturbation weights and receives a fresh one-step validation meta-gradient.

budget.unit: nonnegative within-mini-batch training weight mass normalized to one
budget.denominator: the current training mini-batch rather than the full dataset
budget.unique_sample_definition: The method reweights whatever examples ordinary data loading places in the current mini-batch; it does not define a fixed unique replay set.
budget.repeat_definition: Repeat counts follow the ordinary training sampler; the paper changes per-step weights rather than adding matched replay occurrences.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: All training steps remain, but effective weighted exposure varies by sample and step; no finite total replay-exposure budget is defined.
budget.compute_cost: The paper estimates approximately three times ordinary training time because it requires training and validation passes plus backward-on-backward differentiation.

random_baselines: rectified-Gaussian random example weights normalized within the batch
class resampling and inverse-frequency proportion weighting
hard mining based on highest majority-class loss
fine-tuning baselines given the same clean validation examples

counts: 10 random splits for the MNIST imbalance curve
5 random clean/noisy splits for CIFAR experiments
seed_count.aggregation: MNIST reports an average across ten splits; CIFAR reports mean test accuracy with 95% intervals across five specified background-class trials.

checkpoint_selection: The proposed method is evaluated after fixed training steps; several baselines additionally use noisy hyper-validation for tuning or explicit early stopping, and these are labeled as separate ES variants.

results.claim: 方向性重加权在两类噪声设置中优于论文所列基线，并且五次 CIFAR 划分给出不确定性范围。
results.value: under 40% background flip, the method reports 86.73 +/- 0.48 on CIFAR-10 and 59.30 +/- 0.60 on CIFAR-100

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 表二显示方法在 40% background-flip 下超过比较方法，但其监督来自额外干净验证集。

results.claim: 随机权重本身是强基线，说明动态噪声或正则效应可能解释部分收益。
results.value: random weighting outperformed all compared historical methods on uniform flip and was comparable to baseline on other settings

anchor.quote: The first result that draws our attention
anchor.paraphrase_zh: 作者主动报告随机权重意外强势，因此目标方向法必须与严格随机干预而非弱基线比较。

ablations: clean validation-set size from 15 to 1000 examples
early stopping and fine-tuning variants for competing methods
inspection of learned weight distributions for clean and flipped examples
negative_results: Random rectified-Gaussian weights were surprisingly strong and beat all compared historical methods on uniform flip.
At zero noise the proposed method slightly underperformed ordinary baseline training because the clean validation subset has its own sampling bias.
Training only on the small clean set performed poorly, showing that target alignment cannot replace broad training coverage.
The method incurs about three times standard training cost in the authors' estimate.
failure_conditions: The clean validation set is not representative of the deployment endpoint, causing meta-gradients to optimize a biased target.
The same validation identities are reused for method construction and later method or threshold selection.
Within-batch positive clipping discards complementary examples whose immediate dot product is negative but whose set-level or delayed effect is useful.
The method is compared with random sampling rather than an equal-compute random weighting or replay intervention.
limitations: This is per-step reweighting, not finite-budget replay or global sample selection.
It requires a separate accurately labeled unbiased validation set and assumes that its objective represents evaluation utility.
Reported endpoints are ordinary classification accuracy under synthetic imbalance or noise, not FN95 local safety metrics.
The random baseline randomizes weights rather than matching Stage1 replay identities, unique count, repeats and cumulative exposure.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文为 A 提供最直接的一阶依据：训练样本只有在其更新方向降低独立目标损失时才获得正权重。Stage1 可把独立 val_target 上的 FN95 局部成对损失作为目标，并比较 positive alignment、negative alignment 与 gradient norm；但要采用上一 epoch 状态、固定曝光以及独立 val_study 才能避免同时态和验证泄漏。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 论文不支持把梯度点积直接称为 replay 价值，更不支持从普通干净验证 CE 外推到 FN95。它没有固定 unique IDs、累计额外曝光或基础样本顺序，也没有 R1/R2/no-replay 三联；正点积只是一阶局部方向，长期重复、非凸路径、样本互补和跨 seed 反转仍须真实干预检验。
